AUSTIN, TEXAS 78712
University Station, Box X Phone 512-471-1534
April 27, 1976
Mr. J. L. Johnson, P.E.
Acting Chief, Engineering Division
Department of the Army
Fort Worth District
Corps of Engineers
P.O. Box 17300
Fort Worth, Texas 76102
Dear Mr. Johnson:
This letter is in response to your letter dated April 22 to Dr. Charles G. Groat, Acting Director of the Bureau of Economic Geology. You requested that we inform you of any "land use plans" or mapping projects that we might have in preparation for the Lake Amistad area. We have no immediate plans for work in the Lake Amistad area.
We have recently completed two mapping projects that include the Lake Amistad area. The bedrock geology of the Del Rio (1:250,000 AMS Sheet) has been mapped and is in cartographic preparation. State-wide Land Use of Texas (1973) interpreted from ERTS imagery is on open file. Its scale is 1:250,000.
Sincerely yours,
Thomas C. Gustavson Acting Coordinator
Land Resource Laboratory
